notes: The repository includes an 18-passage baseline, a 36-passage complete corpus, a 21-passage curated clinical subset, and a 101-passage expanded research corpus. These collections combine curriculum excerpts, source summaries, terminology context, and author-curated classical or institutional passages; see source_registry.csv for provenance and rights notes. The separate synthetic demo corpus uses synthetic_reference_paraphrase_not_source_evidence. Summaries are not verbatim excerpts. No records are domain-expert-reviewed. Reuse/redistribution rights remain unreviewed. Do not ingest this schema file as evidence.
